 Melbourne Tattoo Company is a beautiful tattoo studio right in the centre of Melbourne City opened by Matt & Zoe Wisdom in 2013. Only a stones throw from Bourke Street Mall, but still hidden enough to keep a private feeling to the tattooing space. Located down one of Melbourne’s many iconic laneways Somerset Place, just off Little Bourke St will bring you to the shared doorway and set of stairs. Head all the way to the top floor and you'll find the front door opening into the large, bright open plan studio. There are currently 10 amazing tattooists who work out of Melbourne Tattoo Company, covering a mixture of styles including American Traditional, Japanese, Black & Grey, Fine Line etc and all enjoy the chance to do walk-in tattoos between appointments.

Walk-in tattoos welcome! We work by appointment but gladly accept walk-ins if our schedule allows. If you don’t have an appointment we do recommend calling ahead to check availability.

Melbourne Tattoo Company | Open Monday to Saturday. Sunday By Appointment Only | Melbourne CBD | Walk-ins welcome! | Call [redacted-phone] for bookings & enquiries
